title: DEF CON 24 - Chris Rock - How to Overthrow a Government
summary: A DEF CON 24 talk on how a cyber mercenary group could forge identities and create the conditions for overthrowing a government. It is entertainingly outlandish and includes a drone-mounted saw for cutting power lines.
why: HN recommends it as an amazing, entertaining talk and cites it in threads on power-line sabotage and coup tactics.

quote.text: If you've not seen this amazing talk I can't recommend it enough.
